reference_kind: Actual GLTFLoader canonical GLB, animated POSITION/NORMAL key weights, and unchanged shared DQ adapter, original-ID positions passed in memory.
domain: All actual exported triangles incident on any>50%arm/hand/finger or whole-leg weighted vertex; one boundary ring retained. Both whole arms/hands vs both whole thighs/calves/feet.
method: Blender BVHTree broad phase followed by mathutils ray-triangle segment tests in both directions and coplanar2Dcontainment/edge tests. Shared-original-ID adjacency excluded.
limits: Discrete151frame surface crossing check; no continuous-time or fully-enclosed-volume certification. Positive-clearance/nearest-normal penetration diagnostics remain separate.
